items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: Next week Bob Minter is coming and we’re playing a program of funk music

ctx.x: What a thrill to sit down and get a new piece passed out to you by Mike Abene or any of these fantastic writers.

It is absolutely a thrill and it has really been also such an education for me as a musician to be immersed in all these different sounds and every week something different. A couple of weeks ago we just did a program with Vince Mendoza — he arranged Michel LeGrand’s music. Next week Bob Minter is coming and we’re playing a program of funk music and it’s — and especially Michael Abene, you mentioned Michael, he is such a hero to me. He’s maybe ten years or eleven years that he was our principal conductor. I think…
out of a big band. And my ears have really, really opened up because I have had the opportunity to play all this different stuff. It’s a real privilege.
